@historyTitle.description: Title of the History tab: the user's own capsules.

@historySortBy.description: Sort button (when no sort is chosen) and title of the sort menu. Short: the button is a third of the screen.

@historyFilterBy.description: Filter button (when no filter is chosen) and title of the filter menu. Short.

@historyReset.description: Button and menu item that clear the sort and/or the filters. Short.

@historySortRelevance.description: Sort menu group that holds 'From Oldest' and 'From Newest'.

@historySortDistance.description: Sort menu group that holds 'From Closest' and 'From Farthest'.

@historySortOldest.description: Sort option (also shown on the sort button): oldest capsules first.

@historySortClosest.description: Sort option: capsules closest to the user first.

@historyFilterColor.description: Filter menu group: the colour of the capsule pin.

@historyFilterVisibility.description: Filter menu group: who can see the capsule (public, private, friends).

@historyFilterFavorite.description: Filter option (also on the filter button): only capsules marked as favourite.

@historyFilterAny.description: Filter option: every capsule, favourite or not.

@historyColorRed.description: Capsule pin colour in the filter menu and on the filter button.

@historyPrivacyPublic.description: Capsule visibility in the filter menu and on the filter button.

@historyPrivacyFriends.description: Capsule visibility: only friends can see it.

@historyVisibilityPublic.description: Info row of a capsule in the list, next to a privacy icon. One short line.

@historyCapsuleOpened.description: Countdown row of a capsule whose opening time has passed.

@historyCountdown.description: Time left until a capsule opens, ticking every second. One short line: use compact unit abbreviations.

@historyCountdownYears.description: Time left until a capsule opens when it is a year or more away. One short line: compact unit abbreviations.

@historyDistanceFromYou.description: Distance between the user and the capsule. One short line.

@historyDistanceUnknown.description: Distance row when the capsule or the user has no location.

@historyAddToFavorites.description: Accessibility label of the heart on a capsule that is not a favourite.

@historyRemoveFromFavorites.description: Accessibility label of the heart on a favourite capsule.

@historyFavoriteAdded.description: Toast after the heart is tapped.

@historyFavoriteRemoved.description: Toast after the heart is tapped again.

@historySelectedCount.description: Selection bar: how many capsules are selected.

@historyDeleteSelected.description: Selection bar button that deletes the selected capsules.

@historyDeleteConfirm.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting the selected capsules.

historyDeleted: {count, plural, one{{count} capsule deleted} other{{count} capsules deleted}}

@historyDeleted.description: Toast after the selected capsules were deleted.
